source_description: User-authorized selection from the Frontier Technology Genesis outputs; original workspace and open editor kept untouched.
disclosure: The user explicitly asked to add relevant files from this research mission to the public repository. No files from private work/checkouts or unavailable experimental datasets were imported.

selection.scope: All technology notes, code, assumed-model outputs and failure records; updated account/ledgers/state/provenance/checksums; preservation/replay receipts. Earlier unchanged mathematics and phase-two history use exact DU aliases.
selection.reason: One local typesetting receipt intentionally excluded; every scientific/source file is recoverable through a new copy or exact alias.
